tasks.label: demo: dev
tasks.detail: Everything needed to work on the demo locally: SQLite, stubbed S3, live CSS.

tasks.label: demo: install
tasks.detail: Python deps, front-end deps, and a first CSS/htmx build. Run once after cloning.
tasks.command: uv sync --group demo && bun install && bun run build

tasks.label: demo: build assets
tasks.detail: One-shot build of app/static/css/app.css and app/static/js/htmx.min.js.

tasks.label: demo: init local database
tasks.detail: Creates the tables in dev.db. Idempotent, so it is safe to re-run.
tasks.command: uv run python -c "from pelican_data_loader import initialize_database; initialize_database('sqlite:///${workspaceFolder}/dev.db')"

tasks.label: demo: serve (local SQLite)
tasks.detail: Serves on :8000 against dev.db with S3 stubbed out, so no credentials are needed.

tasks.label: demo
tasks.detail: Serves on :8000 against the Postgres configured in .env. Needs POSTGRES_HOST reachable.

tasks.label: demo: smoke test
tasks.detail: The check that gates the image build.
